verdict.rationale: Bland's evidence only documents it exposing an outbound MCP server so that external AI coding agents can call Bland's own tools (docs-11, docs-20, docs-27, probe-rt-2) — the reverse direction of this story. There is no evidence that Bland itself can consume/plug in third-party MCP servers as a client; its tool integration story is limited to custom HTTP API endpoints and webhooks (bland-docs-4, bland-docs-25).
